# dsh-insurance-advisor
An agent preset for **individual insurance agents (个险渠道)** on DeepSeek Harness: needs analysis, prop
osals, suitability matching, sales-recording (双录) checks, and policy servicing.
It ships **10 deterministic tools** and **5 skills**, and mounts **no shell tool** — file read/write
is kept, but the model cannot run arbitrary commands against client data.

## What it adds
### Agent preset
One preset (`insurance-advisor`, order 20) composing the standard tool set — file, web, todo, schedu
le, present, compaction, delegation — plus the three domain plugins below. `tool-bash`, `tool-pwsh`
and the terminal group are deliberately absent.
### Suitability and authorization — `insurance_check_suitability`, `insurance_authorized_products`
Encodes the product-class / agent-level / customer-risk matrix as deterministic rules instead of lea
ving the model to infer:
| Agent level | Highest product class it may sell |

- A **combination sale** must take the *highest* class among its products (从高不从低).
- **P4 / P5** add

itionally require the customer's risk level (R1–R5) to be at least the product's risk rating.
- `ins
urance_authorized_products` answers the inverse question: which product classes this agent may sell.
### Client and policy ledger — `insurance_crm_*`
Six tools over a `storageDomain`-backed table: `insurance_upsert_client`, `insurance_list_clients`,
`insurance_add_policy`, `insurance_list_policies`, `insurance_service_due`, `insurance_record_touchp
ance_add_policy`, `insurance_list_policies`, `insurance_service_due`, `insurance_record_touchpoint`.
Grace periods are computed from the **receipt date (回执签收日)**, inclusive of the day itself:
| Channel | Grace period |

| `individual` | 10 days |
| `bancassurance` | 15 days |
| `internet` | 15 days |
| `telemarketing`

al` | 10 days |
| `bancassurance` | 15 days |
| `internet` | 15 days |
| `telemarketing` | 10 days |
`insurance_service_due` reports policies still inside the grace period (new-business callback owed)
and renewals falling due inside a configurable window.
### Sales-recording checklist — `insurance_dual_record_*`
`insurance_dual_record_checklist` builds a customized five-section recording checklist; `insurance_d
ual_record_validate` rejects a recording that omits any of `identity`, `materials`, `product`, `disc
losure`, `no-extra-benefit`.
### Skills
`insurance-needs-analysis`, `insurance-proposal`, `insurance-dual-record`, `insurance-compliance`, `
insurance-servicing` — loaded from `skills/` inside this package.
## Host-level and preset-level placement
`insurance-crm` is inserted at the **Host** level, not inside the preset, because it consumes the Ho
st `storageDomain` service. Inside a preset scope it stays pending forever and the preset is reporte
d as broken. The other two plugins live inside the preset, so they activate only when the user selec
ken. The other two plugins live inside the preset, so they activate only when the user selects 保险顾问.
Two consequences worth knowing: the six `insurance_crm_*` tools are available to every agent in the
profile, and the CRM ledger is shared per profile rather than per preset.
## Compatibility

- `engines.dsh`: `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-do
main` are **peer** dependencies with an explicit prerelease branch, so prerelease harness builds are

not silently excluded by node-semver.
- `zod` `^4.4.3` is a regular dependency.
## Deliberately not included
- **No regulatory full-text.** The rules cover the suitability matrix, grace periods and the five ma
ndatory recording sections. Anything else — product filings, carrier-specific clauses — must be chec
ked against the current official text; the preset instructs the model to search for it rather than a

ssert it.
- **No commission, illustration or point-of-sale calculation.** This is not a quoting engi

ne.
- **No client data leaves the machine.** The ledger is local storage; only web search, when the
model chooses to use it, reaches the network.
## Testing
